title: A room's owner records the live session, its reader state together with the call's audio and video

tasks.title: Recordings on the server - tables, binary uploads, list, read, delete, finalise
The recorder in the owner's browser, and the Recording badges

acs.text: WHEN a room's owner posts `POST /api/v1/rooms/:roomId/recordings` THE SYSTEM SHALL create a recording with status `recording` and answer 201 with its id; a member who is not the owner SHALL get 403, a non-member 404, a second start while one is recording 409 `recording.already_running`, and with `RECORDINGS_ENABLED=false` 503 `recording.unavailable`
scenarios: AC-001 only the owner starts a recording, once

acs.text: WHEN the recorder uploads media chunks (`PUT /api/v1/recordings/:id/media/:seq`, at most 4 MB) and state batches (`POST /api/v1/recordings/:id/state`) THE SYSTEM SHALL store them in order; a chunk out of order, too large, from anyone but the recorder, or after the recording finished SHALL be refused with nothing stored; a state message that fails the session schema, or whose `seq` does not continue the stored ones, SHALL refuse the batch
scenarios: AC-002 chunks and state batches are stored in order and checked

acs.text: WHEN the recorder posts `POST /api/v1/recordings/:id/finish { durationMs }` THE SYSTEM SHALL mark it `ready` with that duration; WHEN a recording has had no upload for 2 minutes THE SYSTEM SHALL treat it as `ready` with what arrived when it is next read (and delete it if nothing arrived)
scenarios: AC-003 finishing, and a recording whose recorder went away

acs.text: WHEN a room member lists the room's recordings or reads one THE SYSTEM SHALL return them newest first with title, start, duration, status and owner; `GET …/state` SHALL return a document that parses as the reader's `Recording` v1; `GET …/media` SHALL return the media chunks concatenated in order with the recorded content type; non-members SHALL get 404
scenarios: AC-004 members list and read recordings

acs.text: WHEN the recording's owner or the room's owner deletes a recording THE SYSTEM SHALL remove it with its chunks; anyone else SHALL get 403; WHEN a user is deleted their recordings SHALL be removed, and the deletion walk SHALL find no rows for them
scenarios: AC-005 deleting recordings, and deleting the user

acs.text: WHILE a room is being recorded THE SYSTEM SHALL say so to everyone in it: the room's read and status include `recording: true`, the lobby shows "Recording", the call window, strip and pill show a Recording badge, and the pre-join step says the call is being recorded; WHEN the recording stops all of these SHALL disappear
scenarios: AC-006 everyone in the room is told it is being recorded

acs.text: WHEN the owner presses Record in the lobby or the call window THE SYSTEM SHALL start the recorder in the owner's browser: one clock for state and media, a state keyframe at the start, media chunks every 5 seconds containing the call's mixed audio and a composited video of the visible tiles (a card when there is no call), and Stop SHALL upload the last chunk and a final keyframe and finish the recording
scenarios: AC-007 the recorder captures state and media on one clock

acs.text: WHEN an upload fails three times in a row THE SYSTEM SHALL stop recording, tell the owner, and keep what was stored
scenarios: AC-008 uploads that keep failing stop the recording
